5 Dependencies to other modules
The Time Synchronization over FlexRay (FrTSyn) has interfaces towards the Synchro-
nized Time-Base Manager (StbM), the FlexRay Interface (FrIf), the L-SDU Router (
LSduR), the BSW Mode Manager (BswM), the Default Error Tracer (Det), the Crypto
Service Manager (CSM), and the Intrusion Detection System Manager (IdsM).

FlexRay
• StbM -
– Get and set the current time value
– Get FV from FVM
• LSduR - Receiving and transmitting messages
• FrIf - Accessing the clock unit in the FlexRay controller
• BswM - Coordination of network access (via FrTSyn_SetTransmissionMode)
• Det - Reporting of development errors
• IdsM - Reporting of Security Events
